description_en: Deletes a Web Application Firewall (WAF) member account
description_zh: 多账号统一管理中删除WAF成员账号
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-member-account --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_esasdf30000 --source-ip 0.0.XX.XX --member-account-id 1310000000000039 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteMemberAccount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains this value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account that you want to delete from WAF
parameters.name: member_account_id
